description: This source file contains unit tests for the Packager plugin using Google Test framework. It defines test fixtures and specific test cases to verify the behavior of the Packager component, including initialization, HTTP request handling, installation, and synchronization functionalities.

classes.name: PackagerTest
classes.description: Test fixture for basic Packager web interface initialization and cleanup.

classes.name: PackagerInitializedTest
classes.description: Derived test fixture that sets up mocks and dependencies for testing Packager implementation functionalities like install and synchronize.

methods.name: httpGetPutInstall
methods.description: Test that sends an HTTP PUT request to trigger installation via the web interface and checks for a valid response.

methods.name: httpGetPutSynchornize
methods.description: Test that sends an HTTP PUT request to trigger repository synchronization and verifies the response.

methods.name: InstallTest
methods.description: Test that directly calls the Install method on the Packager implementation and expects a success code.

methods.name: SynchronizeRepositoryTest
methods.description: Test that calls SynchronizeRepository method on the Packager implementation and expects a success code.
